# Amnesty International

> Global human rights movement campaigning, researching, and advocating for a world where everyone enjoys human rights.

Amnesty International publishes research, urgent actions, campaigns, country reporting, and educational resources on human rights issues worldwide. Its website includes organizational information, thematic issue pages, regional and country coverage, news, reports, and ways to take action.

## About Amnesty International
- [Who We Are](https://www.amnesty.org/en/about-us/): Overview of Amnesty International’s mission, history, and global movement.
- [How We’re Run](https://www.amnesty.org/en/about-us/#tab-governance): Governance structure, leadership, and organizational accountability information.
- [What We Do](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/): Summary of Amnesty’s research, campaigning, and advocacy work.
- [Careers](https://www.amnesty.org/en/careers/): Job opportunities and information about working with Amnesty International.
- [Contact Us](https://www.amnesty.org/en/about-us/contact-us/): Contact details and guidance for reaching Amnesty International.
- [Financial and Annual Reports](https://www.amnesty.org/en/about-us/financial-and-annual-reports/): Annual reports, financial statements, and organizational transparency materials.

## Research, Reports, and Publications
- [Research](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/research/): Latest human rights research, investigations, and evidence-based publications.
- [Reports](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/reports/): Published reports covering countries, crises, and thematic human rights issues.
- [Press Releases](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/press-release/): Official statements and media releases on current human rights developments.
- [News](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/): News coverage, reactions, and updates from Amnesty International.
- [Campaigns](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/campaigns/): Current campaign updates and advocacy initiatives.
- [Publications](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/): Central hub for Amnesty’s latest articles, reports, and updates.

## Issues and Human Rights Topics
- [Issues](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/): Main overview of Amnesty’s human rights issue areas.
- [Freedom of Expression](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/freedom-of-expression/): Research and advocacy on censorship, protest, and free speech rights.
- [Refugees, Asylum Seekers and Migrants](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/refugees-asylum-seekers-and-migrants/): Coverage of displacement, asylum, migration, and border rights.
- [Arms Control](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/arms-control/): Work on weapons regulation, arms transfers, and civilian protection.
- [Death Penalty](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/death-penalty/): Campaigning and research to abolish capital punishment worldwide.
- [Torture](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/torture/): Documentation and advocacy against torture and other ill-treatment.
- [Women’s Rights](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/discrimination/womens-rights/): Work addressing gender discrimination and violations of women’s rights.
- [LGBTI Rights](https://www.amnesty.org/en/what-we-do/discrimination/lgbti-rights/): Advocacy and reporting on discrimination against LGBTI people.

## Countries and Regions
- [Countries](https://www.amnesty.org/en/location/): Directory of Amnesty content by country and territory.
- [Africa](https://www.amnesty.org/en/location/africa/): Regional human rights news, research, and campaigns across Africa.
- [Americas](https://www.amnesty.org/en/location/americas/): Regional coverage of human rights developments in the Americas.
- [Asia and the Pacific](https://www.amnesty.org/en/location/asia-and-the-pacific/): Reporting and advocacy across Asia and the Pacific region.
- [Europe and Central Asia](https://www.amnesty.org/en/location/europe-and-central-asia/): Regional analysis, campaigns, and country reporting.
- [Middle East and North Africa](https://www.amnesty.org/en/location/middle-east-and-north-africa/): Human rights coverage across the Middle East and North Africa.

## Take Action
- [Take Action](https://www.amnesty.org/en/get-involved/take-action/): Action hub for petitions, urgent actions, and campaign participation.
- [Urgent Actions](https://www.amnesty.org/en/get-involved/take-action/urgent-actions/): Time-sensitive cases where supporters can act quickly for individuals at risk.
- [Write for Rights](https://www.amnesty.org/en/get-involved/write-for-rights/): Annual global letter-writing campaign for people facing injustice.
- [Get Involved](https://www.amnesty.org/en/get-involved/): Overview of ways to support, campaign, and participate.
- [Donate](https://www.amnesty.org/en/donate/): Donation page supporting Amnesty International’s human rights work.
- [Volunteer](https://www.amnesty.org/en/get-involved/): Entry point for participation and supporter engagement opportunities.

## Human Rights Education
- [Human Rights Education](https://www.amnesty.org/en/human-rights-education/): Overview of educational resources and learning on human rights.
- [Amnesty Academy](https://www.amnesty.org/en/human-rights-education/amnesty-academy/): Free courses and learning materials on human rights topics.
- [Youth and Students](https://www.amnesty.org/en/get-involved/youth-and-students/): Resources and opportunities for young people and student activists.
- [Activist Resources](https://www.amnesty.org/en/get-involved/): Materials and guidance for campaigners and supporters.

## News and Stories
- [Latest](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/): Aggregated stream of Amnesty’s newest content across formats.
- [Stories](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/stories/): Human-centered stories highlighting lived experiences and campaigns.
- [Press Centre](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/press-release/): Media-facing announcements and official responses to events.
- [Campaign News](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/campaigns/): Updates on active campaigns and advocacy efforts.
- [Research News](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/research/): Recent investigative findings and research-driven updates.

## Governance, Policies, and Transparency
- [Governance](https://www.amnesty.org/en/about-us/#tab-governance): Information on governance bodies and organizational structure.
- [International Board](https://www.amnesty.org/en/about-us/#tab-governance): Leadership and oversight information for Amnesty International.
- [Annual Report](https://www.amnesty.org/en/about-us/financial-and-annual-reports/): Yearly summary of activities, impact, and finances.
- [Financial Statements](https://www.amnesty.org/en/about-us/financial-and-annual-reports/): Audited financial information and accountability documents.
- [Cookie Statement](https://www.amnesty.org/en/cookie-statement/): Information about cookies and tracking on the website.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.amnesty.org/en/privacy-policy/): Data protection and privacy practices for site users.
